# Dummy data (synthetic, for reviewers)

Every provider, name, address, account number and amount in these PDFs is invented. Each page carries a
"SYNTHETIC DATA" banner. The PDFs are generated by `scripts/make_dummy_pdfs.py` (`make dummy-pdfs`).
`extractions.json` holds the ground-truth structured fields for each PDF. Its line items sum to each total.

## Use

```bash
make run-dummy   # seeds a throwaway vault in .dummy_home/ and starts the app; password: dummy-data-demo
```

You can also upload the PDFs by hand on the **Upload** page of any vault. The category is detected from keywords.

## Sample questions (Chat, needs oMLX running)

| Ask | Expected |
|---|---|
| What was my gas bill total in September 2025? | $50.80, due Oct 15, 2025 (not August's $32.10, the Week 3 retrieval bug) |
| What changed on my gas bill from August to September? | +$18.70; usage rose from 18 to 34 therms |
| How many kWh did I use in September 2025? | 845 kWh |
| What did I spend on electricity and gas in Aug-Sep 2025? | $281.07 (84.75 + 113.42 + 32.10 + 50.80) |
| What is my credit card minimum payment and due date? | $35.00, due Oct 20, 2025 |
| What was my checking ending balance in September? | $6,279.05 |
| What is my brokerage portfolio value? | $25,430.18 |
| How much was my bill? | A clarifying question asking which period or account (Coordinator) |
| What was my water bill in September? | "Not found" / no such document. It must not invent a figure |
| Pay my electricity bill | Refused (out of scope) |
